title: Perspective Mod
description: Free-look camera — look around in third person independently of your character's facing
body:
# Perspective

A lightweight free-look camera mod for Fabric. Look around your character in third person without changing the direction your character actually faces — perfect for admiring builds, checking your surroundings, or just playing with a more cinematic view.

## Features
- **Free-look toggle** — press a key to decouple the camera from your character's facing and look around freely.
- **Hold or toggle mode** — choose whether the key toggles free-look on/off, or only activates it while held.

## How to use
Press **F5 by default** (rebindable in Controls) to toggle free-look. While active, move your mouse to look around independently — your character keeps facing forward.
